3,9 for this delicious champagne.

Scent: Medium plus intensity. Tangerine zest, yeast, sourdough, rubber, bitter almond, oxidised apples and a nice minerality.  

Looks: Light yellow.  

Mouthfeel: Dry. Dosage equals eight grams of sugar per litre, which I think brings good structure and balance. ABV is 12%. High acidity. Good for being a non-vintage.  

Grape varieties: 45% Chardonnay, 45% Pinot Noir and 10% "Pinot" Meunier. Maturation on its lees for three years. Malolactic fermentation has been avoided.
